test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, if RIVER is coded as 9 - 18 - 5 - 22 - 9 and VALLEY is coded as 5 - 26 - 15 - 15 - 22 - 2, then how will MOUNTAIN be coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

RIVER is coded as 9 - 18 - 5 - 22 - 9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30237ba51c4eb2ee641136ef14aa002694d24c7fa4049a3c1a2821f569919e6e.png] 

VALLEY is coded as 5 - 26 - 15 - 15 - 22 - 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2a403fcc919324c2bed3657cf5307efa7f1da1e8afcd24d473b89e51d07929b.png] 

Similarly, **MOUNTAIN **will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6822835b2f126d4bae686b1c2e1099e3a21d84463e3395ea1a5c585121d4e5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"14 - 12 - 6 - 13 - 7 - 26 - 18 - 13".**
